name: Nakaya Shiori
source:
The owner of a club that the protagonist's boss is crazy about.

She has a life of misfortune due to her excessive beauty.

Although she knows that her husband has a mistress, she is still deeply in love with him, saying “ because he chose me as his wife then it's okay".

She feels happy to serve her husband.
